purpose: Exhaustive, disjoint primary review ownership for changed files; not semantic, line, test or runtime coverage.
verificationStatus: Static inventory only; no builds, tests, provider calls, Unity or MCP run by the coverage auditor.
rules: Every immutable diff path has exactly one primary owner, including docs, metadata, manifests and test wiring.
A .meta file follows the owner of its companion path.
Domain tests and domain documentation follow that domain; aggregate release, coverage and wiring records belong to group 14.
Ownership permits contextual reads across seams, not overlapping writes or duplicate primary coverage claims.
Historical audit and repair documents are changed files requiring review; their findings are not automatically current PR bugs.

Host authentication, account switching, matchmaking and view policy remain host-game responsibilities. Repeated RoleIds, supplied context, independent logical scopes and documented local/shared-world presets are evaluated against their actual contracts.
Planned CLI model and effort are requested settings, not proof of process launch or successful tool execution.

crossDomainReadSeams.reason: Chat/session integration exercises actor admission and memory partitions; host auditor owns the changed fixtures and document.
UI lifecycle/persistence fixtures have one Hub primary owner; provider and host reviewers may read their integration assertions.
Mods regression coverage and secure-environment changes cross log-retention and trusted-iterator seams; primary ownership remains Mods.
Material lifetime/resource owner reads projection behavior; the shader, projection regression and projection documentation belong to group 13.
Cross-domain compile/test inclusion wiring is reviewed centrally; each included test has its own domain owner.
